subject: english
stem: Leo chose this map because it shows every bus line. What is the role of this?
options: It limits map to a particular one
It refers to the whole earlier sentence
It shows that map is plural

optionRationales.reason: It limits map to a particular one：this 直接放在單數名詞 map 前，指定某一張地圖。
It refers to the whole earlier sentence：this 後有名詞，不是獨立回指整句。
It replaces the verb chose：chose 是動詞，this 不取代它。
It shows that map is plural：map 是單數，this 也標示單數。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「this 或 that 後的評論對哪一整句成立」可推出 It limits map to a particular one；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 It limits map to a particular one 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
